title: AC1024 dynamic-constraint DIMENSION DXF profile
scope: One physical AC1024 mechanical drawing and the generated ASCII/Binary writer control; this receipt does not qualify native constraint evaluation or broader producer/version support.

behavior: DIMENSION entities on the legacy *LayerNameForDynamicConstraint layer with an empty geometry-block name and no block handle omit group codes 2 and 70.
Entity references to the legacy constraint layer are emitted on *ADSK_CONSTRAINTS.
The source-named layer row is retained for raw name references; a matching canonical layer row is added when the source has no canonical row.
The DWG table-output inspector admits exactly that additional canonical alias row for this bounded profile.

checks: legacy and canonical layer rows coexist
constraint DIMENSION omits group 2 and group 70
ordinary DIMENSION retains its geometry-block name and group 70

limitations: ezdxf documents that dimensional constraints are not part of the published DXF reference and that ezdxf does not evaluate them; recognition and zero audit fixes establish profile/readback compatibility only.
No AutoCAD, LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, or FreeCAD native constraint evaluation was tested.
No claim is made for other DWG producer versions, nonempty picture-block cases, or constraint graph completeness.
fixturePolicy: No DXF or DWG test fixture was added to the repository; the physical output is temporary.
